purpose: Test whether the presentation-quality objective reserved for the first grounded Class C trial can be achieved deterministically after the Class C producer failed to execute the edit contract.

geometry.semanticOperation: rotate the already isolated factual two-piece group as one unit into the reviewed horizontal wide-placement orientation

fidelityInterpretation: Both candidates derive only from the exact source pixels, the same factual foreground mask and deterministic interpolation.
No product piece, hole, slot, fitting, terminal or viewpoint is synthesized by the render-quality control.
Partial-alpha pixels are antialiasing evidence, not new factual detail.
Premultiplied-alpha processing reduces edge color contamination compared with naive transparent-edge resampling.

review.observedPresentationChange: The alpha-aware candidate has visibly smoother, less jagged product boundaries at placement size and magnified inspection while preserving the reviewed H45 group geometry.

architecturalReading: For H45, the narrow presentation-quality objective predeclared for Class C can be substantially addressed by a deterministic renderer. This reduces the current evidence for needing generative reconstruction in the ordinary variation path.

relationshipToClassCTrial.conclusion: Do not seek another generative candidate merely to obtain antialiasing/background cleanup. First treat high-quality deterministic resampling as the stronger baseline that any future Class C producer must materially outperform.
